title: Muni route-level service reliability (headway adherence, gaps, bunching, on-time performance, headway CV)
purpose: Inputs for reliability-adjusted waiting time: wait = headway/2 * (1 + CV^2).

sources.title: Muni Service Equity Strategy Report FY 26-27 & FY 27-28 (SFMTA Board 2026-04-07, Item 10.5), Appendix C route performance tables
sources.method: SFMTA AVL. Headway adherence (spacing): % of timepoints served where the actual headway is no more than 5 min longer than the scheduled headway; reported only for headway-managed routes/periods. OTP: % of timepoint departures between 1 min early and <5 min late; reported for timepoint-schedule-managed routes and for headway routes after ~10pm. Periods: Day 6am-7pm, Eve/Night 7pm-1am, Owl 1-6am, weekday and weekend. Covers Equity Strategy routes and Citywide Accessibility routes only (not J, L, N, 2, 18, 28, 28R, 35, 36, 37, 39, 55, 57, 58, 66, 67, 1X, cable cars, F).

sources.title: Muni Service Equity Strategy FY25 & FY26 (SFMTA Board 2024-04-16, Item 10.4), Appendix C
sources.method: Same definitions as sfmta_mses_2026. In this edition OTP is only shown for timepoint-managed routes and owl periods.

sources.publisher: Cal-ITP (Caltrans), public bucket calitp-publish-data-analysis, folder ucd_transit_priority_2026/fct_stop_time_metrics_2026-06-10/ (10 parquet parts)
sources.rawFile: calitp/muni_stop_time_actuals_2026-06-10.csv (Muni rows extracted; parquet parts deleted after extraction)
sources.method: Actual arrival/departure per trip and stop derived by Cal-ITP from the 511 Muni GTFS-realtime TripUpdates feed (agency=SF).

Joined Cal-ITP actuals to SFMTA GTFS (data/beta3/raw/gtfs/muni.zip, service_id M11 weekday; trip_ids match exactly; RT stop_id = GTFS stop_code). 9123 of 9456 scheduled weekday trips appear in the realtime data. For each route/direction/stop (first and last stop of each trip excluded), arrivals sorted by actual time; headway = gap to previous actual arrival; scheduled headway = gap to previous scheduled trip at that stop. headwayCV = sqrt(E[x^2]/E[x]^2 - 1) with x = actual headway / mean scheduled headway at that stop in that clock hour, pooled over stops and directions; waitFactor = E[x^2]/E[x] = expected random-arrival wait divided by (scheduled headway/2) (equals 1+CV^2 when mean actual = scheduled headway). gapPct = % headways > scheduled + 5 min (SFMTA gap definition); headwayAdherencePct = 100 - gapPct (SFMTA-style, computed); bunchedPct = % headways < 2 min (SFMTA bunching definition); onTimePct = % GTFS timepoint departures within -1/+5 min (-60 s <= dev < 300 s). Period by scheduled time. Source rows duplicated with conflicting times for ~11% of trip-stops, concentrated 16:30-19:30 Pacific (UTC midnight partition seam); all records with actual time 16:30-19:30 dropped and headways spanning that window not computed; elsewhere duplicates resolved by choosing the time closest to linear interpolation between neighbouring stops of the same trip, unresolvable ones dropped. Headways that span a scheduled trip absent from the realtime data are kept (could be a cancellation = real gap, or an untracked bus = artifact); pctHeadwaysSpanningUnobservedTrip and the *_excludingSpansOfUnobservedTrips fields bound this. Scripts: data/beta3/raw/reliability/scripts/ (headways.py, assemble.py; gitignored, not in repo).

sources.publisher: TRB, TCRP Report 100, Transit Capacity and Quality of Service Manual 2nd ed., Part 3, Exhibit 3-30 and Eq. 3-7
sources.method: cvh = SD(actual - scheduled headway) / mean scheduled headway; P(headway off by > 0.5h) = 1 - Phi(0.5/cvh) under a normal model; LOS A cvh 0.00-0.21 (<=1%), B 0.22-0.30 (<=10%), C 0.31-0.39 (<=20%), D 0.40-0.52 (<=33%), E 0.53-0.74 (<=50%), F >=0.75 (>50%); for headways <=10 min.

definitions.headwayAdherencePct: % of timepoint arrivals evenly spaced, i.e. actual headway <= scheduled headway + 5 min (SFMTA). A bunched (short) headway still counts as adherent. = 100 - gapPct.
definitions.bunchedPct: % of headways < 2 min (SFMTA "bunching" definition); only computed in calitp_derived rows.
definitions.onTimePct: % timepoint departures from 1 min early to <5 min late (SFMTA uses "up to four minutes late"/"-1 <= diff < 5").
definitions.headwayCV: coefficient of variation of headways (calitp_derived rows only); see source calitp_derived_2026-06-10.
definitions.waitFactor: expected wait for random arrivals / (scheduled headway/2); use as multiplier in place of (1+CV^2) when observed mean headway differs from scheduled.

peakHour.status: notFound for Muni. No hourly Muni boardings were found in any 2024-2026 public SFMTA source (Transtat ridership views are daily/monthly by route; crowding view is by multi-hour period). TEP 2006-07 APC files (archives.sfmta.com/cms/rtep/) give boardings only by period (AM Peak, Midday, School, PM Peak, Evening, Owl), not by hour. Proxies already in repo: server/beta3/reference/peak-hour.json (NHTS 2017 bus riders by hour + Muni GTFS trips by hour) and server/beta3/reference/time-of-day.json (BART hourly SF-station profile, BATS 2023).

cvFromAdherence.relationship: TCQSM normal model applied to SFMTA gap definition: P(h > H + 5) = 1 - Phi(5 / (CV*H)), so CV = 5 / (H * Phi^-1(headwayAdherence)), H = scheduled headway in minutes.

empiricalCheck.source: calitp_derived_2026-06-10, DAY period, 54 routes with >=300 headways

cvFromAdherence.use: For routes/periods with only an SFMTA headway adherence %, CV ~= 1.08 * 5/(H*Phi^-1(adherence)). Example H=10, adherence 0.87: Phi^-1=1.126, CV=0.44*1.08=0.48.

notes: Every number in routes[] with source sfmta_* or press ids is copied from the source; calitp_derived values are computed here from Cal-ITP realtime actuals (method in sources).

SFMTA reports headway adherence only for headway-managed routes in headway-managed hours and OTP for schedule-managed routes; routes switch to timepoint schedules after ~10pm, hence OTP values in eve/night columns of headway routes.

Route-level SFMTA values cover only Equity Strategy / Citywide Accessibility routes (about 40 routes). Non-equity routes (J, L, N, 2, 18, 28, 28R, 35-39, 55, 57, 58, 66, 67, 1X) are covered by calitp_derived only (plus L 90% May 2025 and 67 OTP 40%).

Cal-ITP derived metrics are from one weekday in June (outside the school year). The SFMTA-style adherence computed from them (100-gapPct) is within about +/-5 points of SFMTA Sept-Oct 2025 values for most comparable routes (e.g. 38R 94.3 vs 93, 14R 90.9 vs 92, T 88.7 vs 87, K 89.7 vs 88), but 30 (88.4 vs 80), 49 (95.4 vs 90) and M (89.8 vs 85) differ more.

For timepoint-schedule routes (connectors, owl, many grid routes, mostly 20-30 min headways) riders time arrivals to the schedule, so OTP (not headway CV) is the relevant measure; headwayCV there is reported for completeness.
Cable cars (CA, PH, PM): realtime coverage is poor (CA 108/146 trips, PH 125/225 trips, PM 82/186 trips) - calitp_derived values for them are not usable.
PM period in calitp_derived covers 15:00-16:30 only; the PM peak 16:30-19:00 could not be measured (duplicate conflicting records in source).
